title: Oven Roasted Chinese White Bread Wrap
description: A roasted, fluffy, and comforting Chinese dish featuring white bread, bonito flakes, and wrapped in a lotus leaf, this recipe is a unique twist on traditional Chinese cuisine, perfect for a snack or light meal.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a small bowl, mix together bonito flakes, sesame oil, soy sauce, scallions, and ginger.
Lay a lotus leaf flat on a work surface and place a slice of white bread in the center of the leaf.
Brush the bread with the bonito flake mixture, making sure to leave a 1-inch border around the edges.
Fold the lotus leaf over the bread to form a triangle or a square shape, and press the edges together to seal.
Place the wrapped bread on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper and repeat with the remaining ingredients.
Roast the bread in the preheated oven for 15 minutes, or until the bread is toasted and the lotus leaf is crispy.
Remove the bread from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes before serving.
